lanes.name: Recovery and integration
lanes.scope: Preserve and reconcile local fixes/APK with main and every relevant draft. Publish unique-change/old-lane disposition, canonical imports/migrations, route aliases, dependency integration and final APK/rollback evidence. Update stale shell guards for current decisions; do not drop their security assertions. Confirm Chats/Rooms/Talks/Gwani/Wallet order, Talks ordinary-launch default, semantic saved-tab migration and explicit-destination precedence.
lanes.tests: Combined Flutter analyze/test/build, TypeScript build/unit/contract/DB suites, deep links, account switching, migration rehearsal and qualified final two-device/provider paths. Confirm exact order/labels, centre/default after auth, resume/deep-link/call behavior and old-route compatibility.

lanes.name: MSN financial authority
lanes.scope: Elect existing ledger authority, reconcile #576 and internal crypto transfers, define exact MSN/backing/liquidity rules, implement fiat purchase of MSN, supported crypto deposit/hold/convert/withdraw, transfer/escrow primitives and one receipt/status authority. No spendable fiat/direct fiat cashout or silent Cr migration.
lanes.tests: Balanced postings; real DB concurrency; duplicate callbacks/keys; forged events; quote/consent replay; pending funding failure; treasury/liquidity guards and provider reconciliation.

lanes.name: MSN P2P escrow
lanes.scope: MSN-only offers/order/escrow orchestration and themed Buy/Sell/My orders UI, role-checked dispute console, verified receipt or seller confirmation, frozen paid/disputed orders, reminders and reconciliation. Use AF01 transaction/escrow primitives, never a second ledger.
lanes.tests: Reserve/create atomicity; oversell; paid/expiry races; forged screenshot; buyer/seller/operator IDOR; double-release/refund; restart/offline; qualification per payment method.

lanes.name: Wallet surfaces and receipts
lanes.scope: MSN-first home, crypto holdings, Add/Send/Convert/P2P handoff, funding/withdraw/conversion reviews, durable status and tappable receipts. Preserve #576 panel and real crypto code, remove consumer Cr/spendable fiat with compatible server contracts.
lanes.tests: Exact formatting, stale cache/offline, restrictions, recipient/quote reviews, failed/uncertain recovery and account isolation; no null-swallowed failure or inert actions.

lanes.name: Gwani service menus
lanes.scope: Progressive vertical floating billing choices above composer; same durable draft for menu/text/voice, Back/Change, actual catalog/recipient validation, MSN quote/explicit authorization/receipt/status recovery. Integrate existing tasks rather than duplicate. ai_chat_screen shared hook belongs to AF00 until transfer.
lanes.tests: Menu→text→voice parity; conversation-only purchase; changed terms invalidate consent; no model approval; uncertain provider lookup before retry; localization and low-literacy tap paths.

lanes.name: Audio reliability
lanes.scope: Diagnose recorder vs transport/provider/output stages, capture/preview/upload/readback independent of Gemini Live, shared audio focus, lifecycle release, Bluetooth/headphones, explicit permission flow and useful errors. Give AF00 manifest/session/screen hooks; native permission edits require a visible transfer.
lanes.tests: Actual handset local recording first, two-device notes, denied/revoked permission, contention, interrupted lifecycle, route switch, live send/receive, Bluetooth and subsequent recording after call.

lanes.name: Messaging and chat transfers
lanes.scope: Recover canonical DM implementation rather than maintain competing messages/human_messages stacks. WhatsApp-like compact composer, recorder preview/retry, durable outbox/realtime/history and MSN/crypto transfer sheet/card using AF01/AF03 contracts. No private money in public content.
lanes.tests: Two-device send/readback; restart/idempotent outbox; blocked users; account switch; media retries; chat failure after successful transfer; receipt parity and no duplicate charge.

lanes.name: Masana and Contacts directory
lanes.scope: New chat opens Masana & Contacts with typed AI/person entries, roles/search/recents/favorites and real accepted people/request lifecycle. Reuse C01/U21; voluntary local phonebook without silent upload or treating an unverified number as identity.
lanes.tests: Correct human/AI route, stable IDs, denied contacts permission, privacy/block/request rules, offline directory, favorite account fencing and return to draft.

lanes.name: Authentication and launch polish
lanes.scope: Email/phone signup/login selectors preserving working email, numeric-password request with server security and unverified phone status, qualified recovery and wallet step-up; centered accessible icon-only language selector and neutral native/Flutter launch variants. Reconcile authoritative auth, do not bolt on parallel identity.
lanes.tests: Guessing/rate limits, secure credential storage, no enumeration, recovery/session revocation, linked accounts, unverified-number impersonation, launch Android12+/night, small screens/keyboard.

lanes.name: Published audio Talks
lanes.scope: Audio-post feed, recording/trim/preview/upload/processing/publish, following/discover, engaging waveform cards, likes/comments/play counts/save/share/report. Reuse media/social/replay assets safely; old live IDs remain typed legacy resources, never coerced into new posts. Own audio-post libraries and connect draft resume; shared search/explore files need exact-path transfer from AF00 with AF07 review.
lanes.tests: Two-account publication/playback/follow/comment; publish retry dedup; codec/size limits; one player; played-time counts/dedup; moderation/delete/privacy; low data/offline drafts.

lanes.name: Audio-focused Rooms
lanes.scope: Persistent groups, membership, roles, invite/join/leave, audio history, moderation and notifications through adapters. Optional live room integration only after qualified session authority; reuse existing live infrastructure without restarting public Talk feed.
lanes.tests: Outsider read/media/join denial, kick/revoke, private invite/block/limits, durable notes, offline/reconnect and independently qualified two-device live audio.

lanes.name: Calls recovery
lanes.scope: Reconcile existing C09 calling, recent/missed calls, typed directory selection, ringing/connect/mute/output/end/reconnect; Chats Calls filter. AF00 integrates push/deep links/composition; do not duplicate those files from old call branches.
lanes.tests: Two physical devices, caller/callee authorization, answer/end races, missed call readback, notification/deep link, microphone release and new voice note afterwards; video retained only if already qualified.

lanes.name: Masana creators and scheduled publishing
lanes.scope: Retain seventeen persona identities, extend distinct editorial profiles, follow/public posts, scripts/sources/AI labels/Gemini delivery, publication scheduler/budget/lease/retry/admin pause and a reviewed sample slate. Reuse scheduler/research workers; no autonomous financial actions or fake personal experiences.
lanes.tests: Listening tests per language/voice/emotion; facts/source attribution; duplicate occurrence/publish, failed/empty audio, budgets/retry/admin pause, block/follow visibility and real generated sample artifacts.

lanes.name: Acceptance, privacy and operations evidence
lanes.scope: Build executable cross-feature/device/provider/restore qualification, threat/privacy/accessibility/performance matrix and redacted evidence. Inspect every old F gate; update expected semantics while preserving security proof. No runtime/CI/deployment mutation or mock-as-real completion.
lanes.tests: AF acceptance matrix, negative authority, escrow/concurrency/restore, real configured providers/physical devices, low-end/offline, artifact identity/rollback. Run only available dependencies; record precise unavailable checks.

lanes.name: Settings, account and activity surfaces
lanes.scope: Recover Settings/profile improvements. Implement concise Settings, account-fenced preferences, avatar/profile, notification and audio/data controls, correct app metadata/support, activity and lifecycle status. Consume AF08 credential/session APIs and AF01 financial obligations; preserve real deletion workflow. No auth/ledger replacement; AF00 integrates push, router and locale hooks.
lanes.tests: SA-A01..08: restart/failed saves/account-switch, profile/avatar readback, blocked-user denial, OS/token notification states, safe scope-confirmed cache clearing, installed metadata/support, server deletion/export with unsettled funds. Never claim request==deletion.

lanes.name: Storage and durable operations
lanes.scope: Inventory/reuse existing stores/jobs and publish DB/storage/job closure contracts. Implement reusable private media lifecycle, retention/orphan cleanup and durable operational adapters; qualify schema roots, backups/restore/capacity and restart. Domain jobs stay feature-owned, AF13 owns independent evidence, AF00 owns roots/migration registry/deploy config, AF01 money. Existing adapter changes require explicit exact-path transfer, not parallel replacement.
lanes.tests: DB-A01..08: actual PG migration/upgrade/concurrency, signed-media access/revocation, coupled DB/object restore, measured capacity, restart/lease/idempotency, settlement-aware deletion. Record unavailable live credentials/devices/providers as NOT_RUN or BLOCKED.

statusSemantics: Allocation template only. Actual active ownership and completion require refreshed factory/claims, PR heads/files/handoffs and executed evidence; partial patches do not exhaust AF lanes.
taskSelection: Complete existing substantive customer milestone before new helper/hardening work; dependencies block exact contracts only.
